title: Kiorr language - Wikipedia
text: Kiorr is a Palaungic language of Luang Namtha Province, Laos.Diffloth & Zide (1992) had listed Con as a Lametic language. However, it is treated as a dialect of Kiorr in Sidwell (2010).[2][3] Kiorr could be a historical name for the Saamtaav people.[4].

title: Kiorr language — Grokipedia
text: Kiorr is an endangered Austroasiatic language (ISO 639-3: xko) spoken primarily by about 5,200 people (as of 2023) in Luang Namtha and Oudomxay provinces of northern Laos.

title: Austro-Asiatic Language Family - Structure & Dialects - MustGo
text: The Austro-Asiatic language family consists of 169 languages spoken in Southeast Asia, in countries located between China and Indonesia. A few are spoken to the west of this area in the Nicobar Islands and in India. The austro– part of the name comes from the Latin word for ‘south.’
